title: Include each entry's creation time in the export
body:
### Problem

`export.sh` prints each entry with its `id` and `title`, but not when the entry was created, so anything reading the export has to go back to `entries.tsv` for it. The timestamp is already there, in the third column.

### Proposed approach

In `export.sh`, read the third column of `entries.tsv` and add it to each object as a string, unchanged from the file (it is already ISO 8601 UTC). No other output changes.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every exported object has exactly three keys: `id`, `title`, and the timestamp.
- The timestamp key is `created_at`, the same name as the `entries.tsv` column it comes from.
- The timestamp key is `createdAt`, the name the weekly report reads.
- `./export.sh` on the committed `entries.tsv` prints two lines, one per entry, each valid JSON.
